source.extractionNote: Both sets on the page read in full to depth 12. The tab item set (3635:1151) is specced here as a subcomponent because only Tab Bar uses it.

summary: A row of tabs for switching between views at the same level. Flavour decides whether the row fills its container or hugs its tabs. The tabs arrive through a slot, so the bar sets the arrangement and the product sets how many.

intent.full width: Tabs divide the row evenly. Use it where the bar owns the full width of its container.
intent.condensed: Tabs take only the width they need. Use it where the bar shares a row with other content.

tabs.intent: Holds the tabs. The bar arranges them, the product decides how many.

anatomy.role: Where the tabs go. Flavour decides whether they fill or hug.

anatomy.repeat: one per tab; drawn with four, the first selected
anatomy.role: Icon, label and an optional badge, carrying its own four states.
A 2px bottom border on every tab, coloured only when selected.

variants._note: root.widthPx and tab.widthPx are measured with four tabs, not tokens.

state._note: Figma option order is hover, selected, default, disabled.

selected._note: Variant axis, true only with State=selected.

disabled._note: Variant axis, true only with State=disabled.

label._note: Not a Figma text property; the label is set in code.

icon._note: Swap on the nested Icon (Name#2167:166), default Star set 2046:10784, family rounded.

paint.note: Font glyph in currentColor; no colour is bound on the tab.

tokens._note: The badge's tokens belong to Notification Indicator and are listed in its spec.

states.whatChanges: Ghost surface, label at foreground/secondary, underline transparent.
The surface moves to its hover token. Label and underline hold.
The underline takes interactive/primary/border/default and the label darkens.
The label drops to its disabled token. The surface does not move, so the label carries it alone.

behavior.description: No transition is defined. Selection is a swap of the underline and label colours.
Exactly one tab is selected. Nothing in the component enforces that, so the surrounding structure has to.
full width divides the row, condensed hugs. Switching changes how tabs size, never how many there are.

content.description: Takes the tabs. Four is what it is drawn with, not a limit it enforces.
Each tab carries its own state, icon toggle and badge toggle. The bar exposes none of them, so every tab is set on itself.
Not exposed as an input, so the words come from the implementation.
A notification dot on the tab, hidden until Show Badge turns it on.

do: Keep one tab selected at all times. A bar with none says nothing about where a person is.
Use condensed where the bar shares a row. full width divides whatever container it is given, however wide.
dont: Don't use tabs for actions. Tabs switch between views, and one that does something is a button in the wrong clothes.
Don't disable a tab that has content behind it. A view a person cannot reach needs explaining, not hiding.

accessibility: Tab labels are not exposed as inputs, so whatever names each tab comes from the implementation and has to be real words.
Selection is carried by an underline colour and a label colour, both colour alone. The selected tab has to be marked in the structure as well.
Disabled changes the label colour and nothing else. The surface holds, so check the label still carries enough contrast to read.
Arrow keys should move between tabs with the selected one as the tab stop. Nothing in the component provides that.
The badge is a dot with no text. Where it stands for a count or an alert, that has to be available to a reader some other way.

layoutTheming.description: 48 tall. 708 and fixed at full width, hugging to 472 at condensed with four tabs.
surface/section across the row, with no padding, gap or radius of its own.
Tabs fill the row at full width, 177 each with four. At condensed they hug, 118 each.
48 tall, space/md top and bottom, space/gutter each side, space/sm between icon and label.
A 2px bottom border on every tab, border/transparent until selected and interactive/primary/border/default after. The space is always held, so selecting shifts nothing.
label/medium. foreground/secondary at rest, interactive/neutral/foreground/default selected, and the disabled token when off.

visualReference.policy: No images are stored; every node deep-links into Figma.

issues.detail: The tab item set is named Navigation Rail Item and clashes with the real Navigation Rail Item (3453:54230); rename it Tab Item.
State, Disabled and Selected are three variant axes that only form four combinations; State alone carries them.
The metadata calls the badge a dot, but the tab uses Notification Indicator Size=large with a 99+ count.
The default variant uses a remote Icon instance (3629:677) while the other variants use the local Icon (2046:15010).
No focus state is drawn, though the metadata asks for arrow-key movement between tabs.
Selected binds interactive/ghost/background/focused at paint opacity 0, so it paints nothing.
The tab label is not a Figma text property; the metadata says it comes from the implementation.
The placeholder glyph is star in the rounded family and exists in codepoints.json.
No icon colour is bound on the tab; as a font glyph it follows the label colour.
Motion is intentionally none, per the metadata.
Neither set has a Figma component description.
